name: dropsuite-mcp
description: Every Dropsuite (NinjaOne SaaS Backup) read, plus fleet-wide backup health, coverage gaps and billing reconciliation from one reseller credential.

dropsuite_access_token.title: DROPSUITE_ACCESS_TOKEN
dropsuite_access_token.description: Authentication Token from Settings > API Settings (the reseller admin token), sent as X-Access-Token.

dropsuite_host.title: Dropsuite region host
dropsuite_host.description: Your Dropsuite region's host (dropsuite.us, dropsuite.com, dropsuite.au and so on), used as https://<host>/api. Leave the prefilled default unless your account is in another region.

dropsuite_reseller_token.title: DROPSUITE_RESELLER_TOKEN
dropsuite_reseller_token.description: Reseller Token from Settings > API Settings, sent as X-Reseller-Token.

dropsuite_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
dropsuite_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

dropsuite_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
dropsuite_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

dropsuite_mcp_http_token.title: HTTP transport bearer token
dropsuite_mcp_http_token.description: Bearer token that `dropsuite-mcp --transport http` requires from every HTTP client (Authorization: Bearer). Leave blank for the default stdio transport, which Claude Desktop uses and which never reads it.

dropsuite_base_url.title: Dropsuite API base URL
dropsuite_base_url.description: Optional. The whole API base URL, such as https://dropsuite.us/api. Leave blank to build it from the region host above.

dropsuite_org.title: Organization
dropsuite_org.description: Optional. An organization id or owner email that points the per-organization tools at one client; the server resolves that organization's token from the organization list. Leave blank to name it on each call.

dropsuite_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
dropsuite_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Dropsuite requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
